You are an ADVERSARIAL code reviewer. Review the changes on this branch compared to origin/staging. Look for:
1. Code quality issues (unused code, dead code, inconsistent patterns)
2. Logic errors and bugs
3. Missing error handling
4. Type safety issues
5. Test coverage gaps
6. Architecture violations (per docs/architecture.md patterns)
7. Security concerns

Changed files:
- kris_ui/models/parameter_list_model.py
- kris_ui/widgets/keyword_chip.py
- kris_ui/widgets/parameter_input.py
- kris_ui/widgets/parameter_panel.py
- kris_ui/main_window.py
- tests/ui/test_parameter_list_model.py
- tests/ui/test_keyword_chip.py
- tests/ui/test_parameter_input.py
- tests/ui/test_parameter_panel.py

Format each finding as:
FINDING N:
  Severity: HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW
  File: path/to/file.py
  Line: number
  Issue: description
  Suggested Fix: how to fix

If no issues found, respond with: NO_ISSUES_FOUND
